Start date: 1840-12-27  
Add 41 weeks = 287 days.  
Add 4 days → total add 291 days.  
1840 is a leap year (divisible by 4, before 1900 rule), so Dec 27 + 4 days = Dec 31, then 287 more days:  
From 1841-01-01, 287 days: Jan (31), Feb (28), Mar (31), Apr (30), May (31), Jun (30), Jul (31), Aug (31), Sep (30) → sum to end of Sep: 273 days.  
287 - 273 = 14 days into October → 1841-10-14.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1841-10-14
